title: Vanishing higher Cech cohomology for all open coverings implies vanishing cohomology on every open
statement: Let $X$ be a scheme [def-pc-scheme] and $\mathcal F$ a sheaf of $\mathcal O_X$-modules [def-weil-sheaf-of-modules-category]. For an open $U\subseteq X$ let $\mathcal F|_U$ be the restricted $\mathcal O_U$-module, $(\mathcal F|_U)(W)=\mathcal F(W)$ for $W\subseteq U$ open [lem-weil-pbc-module-restriction-open-immersion-colimits], and $H^p(U,-)$ the cohomology of the scheme $U$ (an open subscheme of $X$), the right derived functors of $\Gamma(U,-)$ on $\mathcal O_U$-modules [pqf-def-cohomology]. For an open $U\subseteq X$ and a family $(U_i)_{i\in I}$ of opens with $U=\bigcup_{i\in I}U_i$ let $\mathcal U=\{U_i\to U\}_{i\in I}$ be the corresponding covering of the Zariski site $X_{\rm Zar}$, where $X_{\rm Zar}$ is the site of open subschemes of $X$ with inclusions as morphisms and jointly surjective open families as coverings [def-sc-zariski-site]; in it the fibre product $U_{i_0}\times_U\cdots\times_UU_{i_p}$ of opens $U_{i_k}\subseteq U$ is the intersection $U_{i_0\ldots i_p}=U_{i_0}\cap\cdots\cap U_{i_p}$ with its inclusions (the category is a preordered set, so this is the only choice), and the projection omitting the $j$-th factor is the inclusion $U_{i_0\ldots i_{p+1}}\subseteq U_{i_0\ldots\hat{i_j}\ldots i_{p+1}}$, and let $\check H^p(\mathcal U,\mathcal F)$ be the Cech cohomology [def-weil-pbc-site-cech-complex] of the underlying presheaf of abelian groups $W\mapsto\mathcal F(W)$ of $\mathcal F$ on $X_{\rm Zar}$ for $\mathcal U$ (degree $p$ term $\prod_{(i_0,\ldots,i_p)\in I^{p+1}}\mathcal F(U_{i_0\ldots i_p})$, alternating sum of restrictions as differential). Assume $\check H^p(\mathcal U,\mathcal F)=0$ for every $p>0$, every open $U\subseteq X$ and every such covering $\mathcal U$ of $U$. Then $H^p(U,\mathcal F|_U)=0$ for every $p>0$ and every open $U\subseteq X$. (Stacks states this for ringed spaces, with $H^p(U,\mathcal F)$ the derived functors of $\Gamma(U,-)$ on $\Mod(\mathcal O_X)$, which equal $H^p(U,\mathcal F|_U)$ by Lemma 01E1 (2).)
